mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sekai_Draw_lots_wish (user_id, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sekai_Draw_lots_wish WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND title = #{title}
SELECT * FROM sekai_Draw_lots_wish WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM sekai_Draw_lots_wish WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY completed, create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sekai_Draw_lots_wish SET completed = #{completed}, review = #{review} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN draw_type = 'RITUAL' THEN ritual_id END) + FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(draw_type = 'LEGACY_RITUAL'),0) / 3) AS rituals, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wish_id IS NOT NULL THEN wish_id END) AS topics, COALESCE(SUM(fortune_score >= 90),0) AS highs, COALESCE(SUM(draw_type = 'DAILY'),0) AS dailies FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT code FROM sekai_Draw_lots_achievement WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sekai_Draw_lots_achievement (user_id, code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{code})
